items.headline: Ciena priced an upsized $2.5 billion convertible notes offering due 2031 to fund note hedges, debt repayment, share repurchases, and corporate purposes
Ciena reported fiscal Q2 2026 results, raised full-year revenue guidance to $6.3 billion ±$100 million, and guided Q3 revenue to $1.625 billion ±$50 million
